finding: L2-P2 ra-exchange (Ra Exchange, Fraxtal) — zombie-hunt II phase-2 deep dive
title: Ra Exchange (authorized Ramses V2 fork) on Fraxtal — CL pools + Solidly-style pairs; reward layer never bootstrapped
closed_reasons: Value-bearing implementations are byte-identical to verified audited sources: 8/8 recompiled runtime codes match on-chain code exactly (ClPool, NonfungiblePositionManager, Pair, ClPoolFactory, PairFactory, FeeCollector, FeeDistributor, Voter).
CL positions are ERC-721-gated: collect/decreaseLiquidity/burn/getReward on the 3 value NFTs (1086/36/38, owner = team GnosisSafe 0xC4EB45…) revert !APPROVED for any non-owner.
ClPool.collect keys positions by msg.sender and ClPool.burn(owner=msg.sender) makes direct pool-level theft impossible; pool.collect for an attacker returns (0,0).

Protocol fees are only collectable via ClPool.collectProtocol (onlyFeeCollector). The permissionless FeeCollector.collectProtocolFees(pool) forwards 100% to the team treasury because isTokenLive=false (fork-verified: attacker gains 0).
crAMM pairs hold no excess: balanceOf(pair) == getReserves() on all 63 pairs -> skim() pays 0; k-invariant swap/mint/burn and reentrancy locks intact.

Staking/ve(3,3) layer never started and holds $0: RA totalSupply 0, ve totalSupply 0/epoch 0, xToken 0, Minter firstPeriod 0, Voter totalWeight 0, all 51 gauges and 51 fee distributors have zero token balances, no CL NFT staked in any gauge.

Ramses Oct-2024 FeeDistributor exploit class (tokenTotalSupplyByPeriod inflation) is absent (different older Velodrome-style FeeDistributor design) and unreachable (no veNFT can exist: createLock/vote/getReward all revert).
Flash loans enforce repayment + fee (F0/F1 checks); a compliant flash is net-negative for the attacker. Round-trip swaps lose money (0.35% current fee on pool A + curve).
49-contract balance sweep (all deployer-deployed contracts incl. routers/gauges/factories): zero balances of the 9 main Fraxtal tokens and no native >0.001 FRAX — no hidden value elsewhere.
Stale-price arbitrage bound against the big pools is ~$3-20 gross and ~$0 net after fees (pool A deviation +0.83%, pool B -0.70%, pool C +0.12%).
